title: Trend Micro Mobile Security for Enterprises widget WFUser Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Trend Micro Mobile Security for Enterprises. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WFUser class defined within the web/widget path. The issue results from improper implementation of the authentication mechanism. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
